mechanism_narrative: Higher current industrial production (INDPRO) levels signal robust economic activity and corporate earnings growth, which directly supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO exceeds 100, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 0.5%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that increases equity discount rates and reduces valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 0.5%, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in retail sales (RSAFS) signals strong labor market conditions and consumer spending, which jointly drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 6.0 and RSAFS > 619105.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 260), a high industrial production level (INDPRO > 105) signals an overheating economy that triggers central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 260 and INDPRO > 105, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Higher current housing starts (HOUST) levels signal strong consumer confidence and economic expansion, which directly supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without requiring additional conditions.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST exceeds 1400, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 265, it signals persistent price pressures that prompt the Federal Reserve to raise rates, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 265, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and increase in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals an economic slowdown, which jointly drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 105 and UNRATE > 6.0, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of strong consumer spending (RSAFS > 600000), a rising housing market (HOUST > 1400) signals robust economic growth, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where RSAFS > 600000 and HOUST > 1400, or the Rank IC over a 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.
